raw.query:
WITH target AS (
  SELECT run_id, policy, forecast_model, quantile, window_name, window_span_s,
         window_requests, is_current AS dim_is_current, superseded_by
  FROM provenance.v_dim
  WHERE is_current = true
    AND experiment = 'planner'
    AND pool = 'language'
    AND run_id IN (
      'planner:week_fc_p50',
      'planner:week_fc_p90',
      'planner:week_fc_p90_toto',
      'planner:week_fc_p90_timesfm',
      'planner:week_re'
    )
)
SELECT t.run_id, t.policy, t.forecast_model, t.quantile, t.window_name,
       t.window_span_s, t.window_requests, l.n_requests,
       t.dim_is_current, l.is_current AS latency_is_current,
       c.is_current AS cost_is_current, t.superseded_by,
       l.sla_metric, l.p50_ms, l.p90_ms, l.p99_ms, c.gpu_hours,
       l.source_relation AS latency_source, c.source_relation AS cost_source
FROM target AS t
JOIN provenance.v_pool_latency AS l USING (run_id)
JOIN provenance.v_pool_cost AS c USING (run_id)
WHERE l.is_current = true
  AND c.is_current = true
  AND l.sla_metric = 'ttft'
ORDER BY t.run_id
